summary: Iteration 5: tested landing i18n (PT/FR/EN/ES), profile photo upload/remove/persist and its propagation (feed post cards, comments, direct-chat header), avatar backend endpoints, and how /jobs, /volunteers, /chat, /direct-chat and /profile look at 390px and 1920px. Everything requested works. Pytest: 39/39 passed, including the new test_avatar.py.

minor.issue: AvatarUpload.image has no max_length, so a very large payload is fully base64-decoded before the 600KB check runs. Add Field(max_length=~820_000) to reject it early with 413/422.
Returns 500 when RAPIDAPI_KEY is missing (already known). 503 with a detail message would be more accurate. /jobs triggers this on page load, so the console logs 500s.
No brute-force lockout (playbook item 4). Bearer tokens are used, not httpOnly cookies. This was already the case.

integration_issues.issue: Author avatars in the list are still green-gradient initial circles ('M') and ignore avatar_version, even though Maria has a photo. Use <Avatar/> here for consistency with the feed/chat.

issues: No data-testid on the category buttons, 'Quero Ajudar Alguém', 'Criar oferta pública' or the help-request cards (only volunteers-page has one).
Author circles and the 'Precisa de ajuda' text use an emerald green that is outside the sage #2A9D8F palette.
The first category button in the dialog gets a black focus outline when the dialog opens (auto-focus). A teal focus ring would match better.
The heading reads 'Categorias que você ajuda' for a migrant user, which reads wrong. At 1920px the 'Perfil' header title is left-aligned and does not line up with the centered card.
The chosen language is not saved (localStorage i18nextLng is null), so it resets to PT on reload.

action_items: Optional: use <Avatar userId version> for authors in the VolunteersPage list and add data-testids to its interactive elements
Optional: save the language choice (i18next languageDetector/localStorage)
Optional: return 503 instead of 500 from the jobs endpoints when RAPIDAPI_KEY is missing
critical_code_review_comments: AvatarUploader: the error path calls res.json() unconditionally. If the ingress returns an HTML 413, this throws and the generic toast is shown, which is acceptable.
JobsPage.js (1073 lines), DirectChatPage.js (597) and VolunteersPage.js (633) are large. Consider splitting them.

The avatar GET sets Cache-Control immutable for one year. That is fine because the ?v= version busts the cache, but after a DELETE an old cached URL still serves the image until the version changes. The UI never requests it then, so this is acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Maria now has a test avatar (orange square with a teal circle, 400px). Added one comment 'TEST_ comentário avatar' on Maria's post 26a04a86-bf52-432c-a5e0-232d7614b3b1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_avatar.py covers 401/400/422/413, upload→GET image→DELETE→404, and posts/comments avatar_version. It leaves Maria with a 1x1 PNG at the end, and the later UI tests replaced that with the jpg. /volunteers opens the 'Quero Ajudar' dialog automatically (showModal defaults to true). The landing language pill highlight uses a CSS transition, so wait about 300ms before taking a screenshot.
